originality.rationale: The 1958 theorem fixes the optimum and supplies constructions but not the complete binary equality census. The 1963 survey records extremal sizes rather than the 86-code classification. Four focused database searches found no statement implying the exact labeled count, forced weight profile, or complement/reversal orbit census. The closest modern database hit concerns the stricter non-overlapping-code condition and therefore does not imply the present result. Residual risk is an obscure or unindexed historical enumeration.
residual_risks: An obscure, non-digitized, or poorly indexed historical enumeration of binary length-five equality cases may exist.
